description: We run with AUTH_UNIFORM_ERRORS=true so the API does not reveal which emails are registered, yet POST /api/v1/auth/email/login with an unknown email still answers 422 with `email: notFound`, and a wrong password gives `incorrectPassword`. When we leave the variable unset the response is the generic `incorrectEmailOrPassword` on both fields instead.
data_flow: auth.uniformErrors is read from AUTH_UNIFORM_ERRORS in auth.config and read again by AuthService.invalidLoginException

The specific error map built in AuthService.validateLogin (notFound / incorrectPassword / needLoginViaProvider) is passed into invalidLoginException and chosen or replaced by the generic payload based on the flag
fix: Use the uniform payload when uniformErrors is true (drop the negation) and the specific errors otherwise.
notes: validateLogin delegates all failure responses to invalidLoginException; the negated flag inverts which payload is returned. forgotPassword reads the same flag but is correct.
